game.name: Madagascar 2 (USA)
game.desc: The crazy animals of Madagascar are back on Xbox 360! In this second opus, save the African savannah and relive the best moments of the film. You play as Alex the lion, Marty the zebra, Melman the giraffe and Gloria the hippo. There are 13 different levels, as well as 10 mini-games, using moves specific to each character.
